title: 900 stocks bleed! Why are investors losing money in smallcaps despite strongest earnings?
summary: In the latest earnings season, smallcap companies in India showcased impressive profit growth, surpassing large and mid-cap firms. However, the irony lies in the notable drop in many smallcap stocks, causing a clear disparity with their financial success. While the overall market, led by the Nifty index, climbed significantly, larger companies attracted institutional funds, leaving their smaller counterparts in a tough spot.

title: BSE shares gain over 2% after HDFC Securities raises target price

title: Indian households hold a record ₹90.4 lakh crore in stocks but lost ₹87,000 crore in one quarter
summary: Despite a recent market downturn, equity holdings of Indian households soared to ₹90.4 lakh crore in the September quarter. However, the estimated household equity wealth dipped by ₹87,000 crore during this timeframe. This development reinforces a long-term positive trend in combined household holdings since March 2020, with individual ownership outpacing foreign portfolio investors. Notably, investors under 40 years are now becoming a prominent segment of registered individual investors.

title: APL Apollo Tubes shares extend losses, down 31% in 3 days as HDFC Securities delivers latest downgrade. What are analysts saying?

title: India's net FDI outflows widen to $4.95 billion in September
summary: India's foreign direct investment landscape saw a net outflow of $4.95 billion in September, markedly higher than last year. In the same month, gross inflows decreased by 17.6%, totaling $5.91 billion, impacted by a rise in repatriation and disinvestment. Indian firms invested $4.41 billion abroad. Yet, from April to September, net FDI inflows surged, with total gross inflows up by 15.5% to $60.91 billion.

title: Gujarat overtakes Maharashtra as India's top state for active investors
summary: Gujarat has become the state with the highest number of active investors, surpassing Maharashtra. The data indicates a significant increase in the number of active investors in recent months. Active investors in Maharashtra also increased, but not as much as in Gujarat. Additionally, Uttar Pradesh remains in third place, showing growth in its investor count. The total active unique investors in India reached a two-year high in October.

title: Indian stocks defy Asia rout, hit fresh FY27 highs on global fund rotation

Investor confidence was bolstered by resilient domestic corporate earnings and decreased focus on AI stocks. Key contributors to this rise included ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, and Reliance Industries. Meanwhile, foreign funds recorded significant investments in Indian equities, marking a shift in market dynamics. Overall, Indian markets remained comparatively stable despite fluctuating conditions in Asian markets.

title: Retail investors turn net sellers in November as FIIs pile into Indian stocks
summary: In November, retail investors, mutual funds, and insurance companies sold significant amounts of Indian growth assets. Retail investors experienced their largest selling in history, totaling around ₹24,953 crore. This marks the second consecutive month of outflows from retail investors. Additionally, mutual funds reported their first monthly net selling since August 2022, amounting to ₹34,929 crore. Despite the selling trend, retail investors have maintained a net buying position in 2026.

title: Gold crash triggers auction notices as LTV breaches hit lenders
summary: Gold finance companies are issuing legal auction notices due to breaches in loan-to-value limits amid falling gold prices. This trend has been driven by a significant decline in gold prices over the past weeks. Nearly 40% of gold-loan portfolios have seen their loan-to-value ratios exceed permissible levels. Lenders are encouraging borrowers to provide additional collateral or make partial payments to avoid auctions.

title: Govt mulls special shares to retain control of merged PFC-REC entity

title: PSBs may find it hard to keep lending pace as liquidity tightens

Private sector banks' deposit growth outpaced that of public sector banks, impacting their competitive edge. State-owned banks have expressed optimism about liquidity positions while acknowledging potential pressure on deposit rates.

title: Inflation pressures broaden across India, raising rate-hike risks ahead of RBI's December review
